repos.title: v0.82.0
repos.body:
Hushfeed v0.82.0 has 147 patches for global TikTok 47.7.3 (`com.zhiliaoapp.musically`). It's built on Morphe patcher 2.3.0, so update Morphe Manager to 2.5.0 or newer before you patch (or use morphe-desktop 2.1.1 on a computer). Older ones won't load it.

TikTok moves to 47.7.3, so grab that build from APKMirror and patch it with the same signing key. Your login and settings carry over. You can jump to a date on your Liked grid now, and search what's on your Liked and Favorites tabs. Long comments can fold down to a few lines. `Pause before the feed` puts a short countdown in front of For You, and Hushfeed can tell you when a newer release is out. The settings come in Thai too.

New in this release

- Hushfeed now supports TikTok 47.7.3, and only that one. 47.7.2 isn't supported anymore. Grab the 47.7.3 bundle or APK from APKMirror and patch it with the same signing key, so your login and settings carry over.
- Hushfeed builds on Morphe patcher 2.3.0 now, so it needs Morphe Manager 2.5.0 or newer, or morphe-desktop 2.1.1 on a computer. Older Managers refuse the bundle.
- `Jump to a date on Liked grids` puts a button in the Liked grid's top corner. Pick a year, then a month or the whole year, and your likes start there, so older ones load without scrolling through everything newer. Newest likes in the same menu goes back. It starts off and lives in Hushfeed settings > Feed screen, under the grid sort rows (#350).
- `Show where commenters are from` also checks the country field on a commenter's account, and uses it only when it holds a two letter code (#201).
- `Long press on Profile opens my watch history` makes holding the Profile tab show the watch history kept on your phone, so the long press on For You can keep opening Hushfeed settings. A tap on Profile works as before. It starts off, sits under `Keep my own watch history` and needs the `Feed tab navigation` patch (#172).
- `Long-press Profile to switch accounts` brings back holding the Profile tab to pick another of your accounts, for accounts where TikTok left that hold out. A tap on Profile works as before, and while `Long-press Profile for Watch history` is on, that one gets the hold. It starts off, lives in Hushfeed settings > Feed tabs and takes a TikTok restart (#388).
- `Discover in the bottom bar` puts Discover where Friends sits in the bottom bar, the layout TikTok gives Indonesia, and your region and feed stay as they are. It starts off, lives in Hushfeed settings > Feed tabs and takes a TikTok restart (#98).
- `Friends in the top tabs` moves Friends up to the tabs along the top of the feed, just left of Following, and Discover takes its spot in the bottom bar, the layout TikTok gives Indonesia. Your region and feed stay as they are (#98).
- The Feature Gate Lab can override experiments TikTok reads as a whole object, like the home tab layout. It couldn't reach those before. An override changes only the fields you give it, and it still applies when TikTok sent your account nothing for that experiment (#98).
- The diagnostic report names the code other patch bundles added to your TikTok, or says there's none. A bundle built from the same template as Hushfeed, with the same package names, no longer counts as Hushfeed's own code. When the last crash happened inside one of them, it says which, even when TikTok's own code passed the error along. When a report runs long, `Copy quick report` now drops only the oldest events and keeps every other part whole, this one included. It also lists the last five times Android closed TikTok and why, where it used to show only the last one (#275).
- The diagnostic export has a Font section. It shows which font TikTok's text went out in, whether an imported font loaded (and if it didn't, why), and the Samsung font style on Galaxy phones (#346).
- Settings an update adds get a small dot after their name in Hushfeed settings, and the closed section they sit in gets one too, so you can spot what's new. A dot goes away after the visit that shows it, and a fresh install starts with none (#349).
- `Startup message` shows a message you write each time TikTok opens, with an optional title. Turn off `Close with Back or a tap outside` and only its OK button closes it. Its `Don't show again` button hides that message until you change its title or text, or install or update TikTok again. Rotating the phone or changing TikTok's theme keeps a message you haven't closed on screen, and doesn't bring back one you have. It starts off and lives in Hushfeed settings > App (#347).
- `Check for Hushfeed updates` tells you in TikTok when a newer Hushfeed is out. Once a day at most, when TikTok opens, it asks GitHub for the latest release, and a newer one gets a card listing the first few things it changes. Update opens Morphe Manager (or the release page if Manager isn't installed) and Dismiss hides the card for that release. The request carries your Hushfeed version and nothing else, and the switch starts off. Find it in Hushfeed settings > App, under the startup message rows (#377).
- With a color picked in `AMOLED dark theme`'s options, Profile, Inbox and TikTok's other full pages take that color too. Before, they stayed black. The light look and the video feed don't change (#348).
- `Block P2P video relay` also takes out the LIVE relay's two leftover libraries, about 1 MB more. The split APK bundle never had them, so nothing changes for those installs (#70).
- `Bend the video at the edges` makes the glass pill's rim bend the blurred video behind it the way the edge of real glass does, and it gives the colors there a small lift. It sits under `Blur the video behind the bar`, starts off and needs Android 13 or newer (#231).
- Three new switches under the ring switches, `Remove rings on the feed`, `Remove rings in comments` and `Remove rings on profiles`, pick where the story and LIVE rings come off. All three start on, so nothing changes until you turn one off (#351).
- `Accent color` has two new options, `Like color` and `Save color`. They paint the heart on a video you liked and the bookmark on one you saved, in the feed and in their tap animations, with a preset or a color code you type. They work in light, dark and AMOLED, and with or without a new accent. Both start on TikTok's own red and yellow, which changes nothing (#369).
- `Hide On this day` takes the On this day memory off the front of the Inbox's stories tray, and the stories after it move up into its place. It starts off and sits under `Hide stories tray` in Hushfeed settings > Inbox (#358).
- `Hide profile pictures in comments` takes the commenter's picture off every comment and reply. The name and the comment move over to the left, so there's no empty space where the picture was. It starts off, sits under `Hide the thumbs down on comments` in Hushfeed settings > Comments and takes a TikTok restart (#352).
- `Custom hold speed` under Playback takes any speed you type, like 1.8 or 2.3, for holding a video and for the pull-down lock under it. It takes the place of `Speed while you hold the video`, and leaving it empty keeps that row's pick (#357).
- `Check for already-saved videos` covers `Save the original sound` too. Save a sound you already have, even from a different video that uses it, and you get Open or Save again instead of a second copy (#356).
- `Phone model for effects` under `Report a newer phone to effects` lets you pick the phone the effects server hears about, since an effect turned down for one phone can open for another. Tap it for a list of recent Galaxy and Pixel phones, or pick `Type another model` at the bottom and enter any model yourself. Left alone it stays the Galaxy S24 Ultra (#176).
- `Keep clear screen in the next LIVE` carries clear screen from one LIVE room to the next one you swipe to, so the chat, gifts and buttons stay hidden until you turn clear screen off. It starts off and sits in Hushfeed settings > Playback, next to `Offer clear screen in every LIVE room` (#354).
- `LIVE feed countries` under Hushfeed settings > Region asks the LIVE feed for rooms from the countries you list, like BR, MX, taking turns page by page. TikTok doesn't say which country a room comes from, so this steers the feed instead of filtering it, and a room from somewhere else can still turn up. Nothing else in TikTok sees the change. It needs the `Region spoof` patch but none of its switches, and it starts empty (#355).
- The diagnostic export has a Captions line. For each For You video it says whether TikTok sent caption tracks, and when it sent none, the reason TikTok gave, like not authorized or language not supported. That way an account whose captions never show can tell whether TikTok sends any at all (#217).
- Two new switches in Hushfeed settings > Comments, `Hide the close button in comments` and `Hide the expand button in comments`, each take one button off the top of the comments, and the buttons beside it move over into its place. Back or a swipe down still closes comments. TikTok only shows the expand button to some accounts. Both start off (#371).
- `Hide the search button on the feed` also hides the magnifying glass TikTok puts over the shrunken video while comments are open (#371).
- `Invisible controls button` puts a small eye at the top left of the main feed. Tap it and the buttons, caption and tabs turn invisible but keep working where they are, which helps against burn-in on OLED screens. Tap the eye again and they're back. Your choice sticks across videos and restarts. The eye stays off other tabs, comments, Clear display and videos you open from a profile or search, and Pause brings everything back. `Keep the caption in sight` under it leaves the creator's name, the caption and the music line showing. Both start off and sit in Hushfeed settings > Feed screen, under `Keep faded controls in Clear display` (#374).
- `Hide Send to new group` takes the gray Send to new group button off the share sheet when you've picked two or more people, so Send separately is the only button left. It starts off and sits under `Hide the Send to row` in Hushfeed settings > Share sheet (#375).
- `AMOLED dark theme` has a switch now. `AMOLED dark mode` in Hushfeed settings > App starts on, and turning it off brings back TikTok's own dark grays after a restart, so you can keep the patch in and still pick plain dark mode. The color you picked in the patch's options stays for when it's on. Pause Hushfeed turns it off too (#372).
- `Make sticker` in a video's share sheet opens TikTok's own sticker editor for that video, so you can trim it, add text and save it as an animated sticker, even on videos where TikTok doesn't show its Create sticker button. If the editor can't open, the video's cover becomes the sticker like before (#214).
- `Automatically record LIVEs you enter` starts recording a LIVE's stream the moment you walk into the room. Swipe on to the next LIVE and that one starts recording too, while the one you left finishes saving in the background. Tap Stop and it stays stopped until you leave and come back. Screen recordings still need your tap and Android's permission. It starts off and sits under `Record LIVEs you watch` in Hushfeed settings > Playback. Thanks to Hiiva for building it (#363).
- `Drag handle and jump buttons on grids` shows a handle at the edge of a long profile, Liked or sound grid while it moves, with Top, Back and End buttons beside it. Back returns to where you were before the last jump. It starts off and lives in Hushfeed settings > Feed screen (#378).
- `Bottom bar icons` in Hushfeed settings > Feed tabs picks one of the icon sets TikTok is testing for the bottom bar, or leaves it to TikTok, which is how it starts. It takes a TikTok restart (#285).
- With `Log diagnostics` on, the report keeps TikTok's answer to every LIVE like, so a like TikTok refused can be told from one that never left the phone (#380).
- The settings screen now comes in Thai. Thanks to @MangaThatsFine (#381).
- `Pin more chats` lets you pin more than 5 chats in the Inbox. TikTok's app stops you at 5 even though its website doesn't, and pins you make there already show up in the app. It starts off, sits under `Show inbox filters` in Hushfeed settings > Inbox and takes a TikTok restart (#385).
- `Hide voice comments` takes voice comments out of a comment thread, replies included, the way `Hide picture comments` does for pictures and stickers. Your own voice comments stay. It starts off and sits under `Hide picture comments` in Hushfeed settings > Comments.
- `Also filter it` follows up a tap on the Not interested button. A short list offers the video's creator, its sound and up to three of its hashtags, and the one you pick goes on the feed filter's own list, so those videos stay gone even after TikTok forgets the feedback. Undo on the banner takes it back off. Cancel just closes the list, and the feedback still goes to TikTok. The sound is offered only while `Hide videos with blocked sounds` is on. It starts off and sits under `Show the Not interested button` in Hushfeed settings > Feed screen.
- A hashtag on a word list now hides only that tag. `#cat` used to hide `#cats` and `#catholic` too, and now it leaves them alone, which is what you'd expect from a tag. Write `cat` without the # to catch every word that has it. Tags written together, like `#fyp#cat`, still count one by one. The Turkish dotted and dotless i and the Greek final sigma now match on word lists and blocked sound names however they're typed, and the keycap emoji no longer counts as a hashtag.
- `Search Liked and Favorites grids` puts a Search button at the top of the Liked and Favorites tabs. Type a word from a caption, a creator's name or a sound and the grid shows only the loaded videos that have it, in any case, with a count of how many match. While a search is on, the grid keeps loading on its own so it looks past the first screen. Clear brings the whole grid back in its sort order. Turning the switch off (or Pause) clears the search too, so turning it back on shows the whole grid with its Search button. It starts off and sits under `Jump to a date on Liked grids` in Hushfeed settings > Feed screen.
- `Fold long comments` cuts a long comment down to its first 4 lines with "more" at the end, and a tap on more opens the rest right in that row. Replies and the creator's comments fold the same way. `Fold after` sets how many lines show, from 1 to 20. It starts off and sits under `Links in comments open` in Hushfeed settings > Comments.
- `Pause before the feed` puts a short countdown in front of For You the first time it opens after TikTok starts or comes back from the background. Continue lights up when the count ends, and Leave TikTok sends the app away instead. Messages, profiles and search open without it, and a trip to messages doesn't start the count over. It's in seconds (0 to 60), starts at 0 (off) and sits under `Don't start the first video` in Hushfeed settings > Screen time. Making it shorter waits a day when `Wait a day to loosen the budget` is on, like the budget's own numbers.

Bug Fixes

- `Blur the video behind the bar` shows the video in the glass pill again on TikTok 47.7.3. The player now draws a smaller picture than the space it fills on screen, and the blur asked for a part of it that didn't exist, so every read failed and the pill stayed plain glass. LIVE previews in For You are found again too, since the LIVE player now builds its picture layer on its own (#259).
- With `See-through bottom bar` or `See-through status bar` on, a video no longer shrinks for a moment and grows back right after you swipe to it. As each video starts TikTok puts the picture back to its own size, and for a moment lays the player out a little shorter, and Hushfeed now fills the picture again for the player's real size before each frame is shown (#390).
- Saving works again behind a proxy app whose fake-IP mode answers with an IPv6 address from its own private range, like mihomo's `fdfe:dcba:9876::/64`. Hushfeed only knew the narrower fc00::/18 range, so every video and photo save stopped with "Media URL resolves to a non-public address". Any private IPv6 range a fake-IP proxy hands out counts now, and when a save is still turned down for a local address, the message names the range instead of saying nothing (#387).
- A comment row could show the translated text of the comment it held before. TikTok reuses rows as you scroll, and a row it reused for a picture or sticker comment kept listening for the old comment's translation, so a translation landing for that comment afterwards (from `Auto translate comments`, say) showed up in the wrong row until you scrolled. A row now stops listening for its old comment as soon as it gets a new one. With `Auto translate comments` on, a row could also keep the other video's comment when you opened one video's comments right after another's, because the translation request went out while TikTok was still filling the row in. It now waits until the row is done (#383).
- With `Hide unpersonalized For You videos` on, a For You batch that's nothing but fill-in now keeps just its first video instead of all of them, so far fewer unpicked videos slip through while the feed still has somewhere to go. Thanks to @yokkkoso (#391).
- A mouse wheel or touchpad scroll over the daily hold, the tap to start stop, the App lock screen, the Start page cover or the profile grid's sort hold no longer scrolls what's behind it. A hold too tall for the screen scrolls itself instead.
- On the App lock screen TalkBack goes straight to Unlock and reads "TikTok is locked" along with it. It used to stop on the title by itself first.
- With App lock on and `Open TikTok on` set to Inbox, Profile or another tab, TalkBack and Tab reach Unlock right away while TikTok opens. The start screen used to hide the lock screen from them for up to 8 seconds.
- During the daily hold, pressing the right arrow key on the last tab no longer slides TikTok over to a creator's profile, and TalkBack's scroll actions can't page it there either. Arrow keys still move between the tabs and the hold's buttons.
- `Latest first on Following` loads further ahead. TikTok sends only a few posts per read on Following and asked for more just three posts before the end, so a newer post often showed up after you'd already scrolled past older ones. With the switch on, the next read starts while about a dozen posts are still waiting below you, so more of them are sorted before you get there. With it off, Following loads the way TikTok does (#226).
- While App lock is up, a dialog, sheet or popup TikTok opens no longer shows on top of the lock screen or takes a tap. One that was already open when TikTok locked goes behind it too, and after you unlock they're back as they were.
- `Remove LIVE extras` leaves the files LIVE invitations, co-hosting, joining as a guest and battle scores run on alone now. Picking every patch used to empty the guest call library, so friends' invitations never showed up and joining a LIVE failed. The patch is down to the LIVE games script and animated gift effects, so it saves very little space now (#382, #107, #132).
- `Icon picture` in `Custom launcher icon` takes the folder Morphe Manager's picker hands back. It uses the only PNG in that folder, or the one named `icon.png` when there are several, and otherwise stops and names the PNGs it found. The hidden `._` copies a Mac leaves next to each picture on a memory card don't count, and a folder that can't be read says so instead of claiming it holds no PNG. Before, picking a folder stopped patching with "there's no file" until you typed the file name in by hand (Discussion #288).
- With `Check for already-saved videos` on, saving something you already have no longer flashes "Saving" right before Open or Save again comes up. That note now waits until the check finds it's new, for sounds, original photos and photo posts saved as a video (#356).
- A LIVE quality you pick stays picked after TikTok restarts as soon as `Offer LIVE quality in more rooms` is on. `Keep the LIVE quality after TikTok restarts` used to start off as well, so the next launch opened rooms at Auto again. It starts on now, and you can still turn it off (#353).
- With `Hide CAPTCHA popups` off, which is how it starts, a puzzle that shows while you're just browsing (in a LIVE room, say) now gets a short note naming that switch. It shows once a session, and never for a puzzle the switch would show anyway, like a sign-in check (#87).
- Hiding Report from the share sheet doesn't take `Block this creator` with it anymore. Block sits where Report would have been, in the share sheet and in the long-press menu (#367).
- With `Open TikTok on` set to Profile, Inbox, Friends or Discover, For You doesn't flash up for a second before that tab anymore. TikTok always builds Home first, so the start screen now stays up until your tab is showing (#360).
- With `Open TikTok on` set to Profile, Inbox, Friends or Discover, the phone's Back no longer drops you on For You. Back from another tab takes you to the one TikTok opens on, and Back there closes TikTok the way it closes any other app. When `Search instead of Home` or the feed lock has TikTok open on Inbox or Profile instead, Back follows that tab. Picking For You or Following keeps TikTok's own Back (#360).
- With `Let other apps play until a video starts` on, your music comes back about a quarter second after you leave a paused video for the inbox, a chat or a profile. It used to stay quiet for a second or two first (#283).
- A bio handle with a period and a date stuck to it, like @john.doe11/30/24, stays plain text now. In 0.81.0 it linked only the part before the period, which opened a different account (#247).
- With `Long-press Profile for Watch history` on, holding Profile opens Watch history again after you remove your second account. Before, the hold did nothing until TikTok rebuilt its tab bar (#341).
- Hushfeed adds less lag when a video opens from Search or Explore. The part that hides buttons on videos rebuilt its whole lookup list on every screen layout while the page opened, and now builds it once. With `Playback quality` set, each video's addresses get checked once too, instead of again in every place the player asks (#344).
- LIVE Auto tap taps the host's side of the stream now. In a battle or a room with guests it used to tap near the middle, hit the other creator's half and open their profile card, which stopped it after a second. If a tap still opens a card, the next start in that room skips that spot (#335).
- With `LIVE recording source` set to Screen, a recording keeps going after you allow it. Android's permission screen made TikTok think you were leaving the room, so TikTok shrank the LIVE into its own picture-in-picture window and the recording stopped a few seconds in.
- On some phones the screen blinked each time a video slid under the bar with `See-through bottom bar` on. The new `Stop the blink under the bar` switch under it has TikTok draw the video inside its own window instead of on a separate layer, which those phones were dropping for a frame. It starts off and takes a TikTok restart (#232).
- `See-through bottom bar` works on the Following tab too. TikTok keeps a strip the height of the bar at the bottom of that feed and paints it black, so the video there still stopped above the tabs. That strip goes clear with the switch now (#232).
- With `See-through bottom bar` on, the still picture TikTok shows while a video starts lines up with the video when TikTok has moved the video up a little. It used to sit higher than the video, with a dark strip under it (#232).
- An imported font and `Use system font` now reach TikTok's own screens, like its Settings pages, on installs patched from the split APK bundle. TikTok's fonts aren't in the bundle, so TikTok had nothing to swap and fell back to the phone's default font. Bold text stays bold (#346).
- `Hide TikTok Shop` also hides the "Find <product>" button with the shopping bag that sits above the search bar on some videos. 0.81.0 only caught a different Find bar, and the diagnostic export now counts this button on its own line (#271).
- `Remove story rings` and `Remove the LIVE ring` take the rings off on the feed, in comments and on profiles again. TikTok 47.7.2 hands each picture its story status directly and asks a different place whether someone's live, so the old hooks missed most of them. The stories trays at the top of the Inbox, Following and Friends keep their rings, because TikTok takes anyone without one out of the tray (#351).
- `AMOLED dark theme` reaches the popup that says "You'll see fewer posts like this" after Not interested, the comments' sort menu and TikTok's other toasts and small popup menus. They stayed gray before (#368).
- With `AMOLED dark theme` on, the X that closes the comments no longer sits on a gray circle. The circle takes the AMOLED color now, along with other buttons and rows on TikTok's sheets drawn in that same gray. Turning off `AMOLED dark mode` brings the gray back (#371).
- With `Dark LIVE panels in dark mode` on, the names in a LIVE's moderator settings and its muted and blocked lists read white on the dark sheet. They came out dark gray before. The "Support this LIVE" bubble over the gift button keeps its dark text on white too, where it had turned white on white (#362).
- `Remove creation tools` keeps the camera's face model and the effect editor library now, so face effects, Retouch and All effects work with it in. It still takes out the two big effects engine libraries TikTok doesn't load for any of that, about 45 MB, on the APK and on the bundle alike (#285).
- The Suggested accounts heading in the Inbox lines its title and info icon up with `Clear all` again. Hushfeed's taller Clear all button had pushed them up above it (#358).
- With `Compact comment header` on, the translate and close buttons no longer sit on top of the first comment. TikTok 47.7.2 moved them out of the header into their own row, so they stayed behind when the header went away. They're hidden along with the rest of the header now (#358).
- Profiles with their own stickers show the Stickers tab again on TikTok 47.7.3, and tapping it opens their sticker sets and video stickers instead of a "Something went wrong" page (#214).
- With `Dark LIVE panels in dark mode` on, Video quality under a LIVE's Share menu is dark all the way through. Its sheet went dark before, but the list of qualities sat on a white card with dark text, and its close X was nearly black on black (#168).
- The install steps now say to patch TikTok with Hushfeed's patches alone, since another source picked beside it can add to the memory patching needs. They also say what fit in tests with the 1 GB a 32-bit Manager can give the patcher. Simple mode's patches did, and so did every patch at once except with `AMOLED dark theme` and `Region spoof` both on, so turn on only one of them there (#339, #252).
- Patching with Simple mode's patches needs less memory. `Allow screenshots and Circle to Search` no longer rewrites the spots in TikTok that only keep the screen on or go full screen, which is about half the ones it touched. On 47.7.3 that's 1324 classes rebuilt instead of 1460, and patching now finishes with 832 MB where it used to need 896 MB (#339).
- Patching with Simple mode's patches needs less memory again. `Turn off haptics` no longer rewrites the 443 spots where TikTok gives a view a long-press action. It quiets the long-press buzz from TikTok's screens instead, while your finger is down, and text fields keep their selection buzz. On 47.7.3 that's 1057 classes rebuilt instead of 1324, and patching finishes with 768 MB (#339).
- With a color picked in `AMOLED dark theme`, a LIVE room's comment bar, its emoji picker and the boxes behind the picker's send and delete buttons take that color under `Dark LIVE panels in dark mode`. They used to stay TikTok's own dark gray, so a tinted theme showed two shades there. With the default black they look the same as before (#329).
- The build no longer pulls in a Guava or Netty release with known advisories against it. Guava moves to 33.8.0, past CVE-2026-118042, and the Netty that Android's test tools bring along moves to 4.1.139, past a critical netty-handler advisory. None of it reaches the app on your phone.
- The README's install steps name the TikTok version a release was built for once that release is out. 0.80.0 and 0.81.0 went out with the steps still pointing at the TikTok before it.
- `Disable telemetry` also stops TikTok's Orbu log upload and its whoami lookups, which were still going out on 47.7.3 (#379).
- `Hide surveys` takes the interest buttons off a video by their own view as well, for when TikTok builds them some other way. The diagnostic report now names each kind of feed component a video was given (#293).
- Blocking a LIVE host with `Block this creator` and swiping to the next room before the block went through no longer closes the room you moved to.
- TalkBack reads the sort button on a profile, Liked or sound grid as a button and says the order it's on, like "Sort this grid: Original order". It only said "Sort this grid" before. The count that shows while a sorted grid loads reads as "30 videos" now, where it was a bare number.
- On a phone set to Arabic or another right-to-left language, the button rows in What's new, the sticker sheet and the Feature Gate Lab run right to left now. The gaps inside the search box, a recent search, the status card and the notices are mirrored to match. In the Lab, a gate's title no longer runs into its value and `Apply overrides` keeps some space from its switch, whichever way the screen reads.
- On a right-to-left phone, a setting's description now sits under its name on the icon's side, and a section's heading starts on that side too. Hushfeed's text is English, so those lines used to start at the far left, across the row from the name.
- `Hide the LIVE button` now shows the restart button when you flip it, like the search and side menu switches. Turned off, the LIVE button stayed missing with nothing telling you it needed a restart.
- If you left a video cleared with `Keep Clear display across videos` on, the first video after you reopen TikTok clears too, instead of keeping its buttons. Its tabs and buttons also stay hidden while TikTok gets ready to clear it, so they don't flash up first.
- With `Hide CAPTCHA popups` on, tapping hearts in a LIVE no longer hides TikTok's check. It shows, the same as it does for a save or a gift, because a hidden check left the hearts on screen while TikTok counted none of them. When TikTok turns your taps down, Hushfeed says so once, the way it does for a video like (#380).
- The sort button and the jump buttons on profile, Liked and sound grids sit on a darker backdrop, so their words read over a white or busy thumbnail (#378).
- The hold speed bubble follows your phone's font size now, in both the pill and the round dial. With large text on, the speed used to stay small while everything else in Hushfeed grew. The whole bubble grows with it, so the padlock and the dots keep their room.
- With `Open TikTok on` set to Inbox, Profile or another tab, TalkBack can't land on the For You feed hidden under the start screen while TikTok opens.
- Restoring a settings backup, resetting settings or undoing either one now updates the feed's text size and color, the commenter names, a searched Liked or Favorites grid, the buttons on the video, feed mute, the comment search box and kept captions right away, the same as flipping those switches by hand. A grid you'd searched stayed narrowed after a restore turned `Search Liked and Favorites grids` off. If one of those can't redraw, the rest still do.
- A switch your patch options turned on now works from the first launch, including the privacy and speed switches TikTok reads before Hushfeed's settings load. Those early reads treated them as off until you'd flipped them yourself.
- `Included diagnostics` shows the choice a restored backup brought back. A saved choice it doesn't know now includes everything, where it used to export an empty log.
- When `Turn back on` can't save, it says "Couldn't save the change. Try again." instead of acting like Hushfeed came back on.
- Shared diagnostics leave out email addresses, phone numbers, account names and your proxy's address. Phone numbers written with spaces, dashes or brackets go too, and so does a nickname of several words or the name in front of your proxy's or router's address. A name with a smiley, an apostrophe or a comma in it is left out whole, and so is one written after a folder path. A time zone like +1000 next to a log's timestamp stays, since it isn't a phone number. A value that starts on the next line of a logged message goes too, along with any password or token written inside it, and a stack trace under an empty field stays readable. Details logged after a video's id, like its place in the feed, stay readable too. Text inside logged JSON, even JSON quoted inside other JSON, is now read like any other text, so a name or number tucked in there goes the same way. Version numbers like 4.12.0.1 and stack trace lines from Scala code stay readable.
- Opening a video from a sorted or searched Liked grid, or from your sorted private videos, now swipes in the grid's order, and a search plays its matches first. Those two grids have a tap handler of their own, so their video page kept TikTok's order while your posts followed the sort (#180).
- On TikTok 47.7.3 the Favorites tab gets its sort button, position rail and Search button. TikTok tucks that grid inside an extra container there, so none of them showed up, and they now sit just under the Posts and Collections row (#180).
- A background job that fails, like the media cache's start-up cleanup, now shows up in the diagnostics log. Before, nothing recorded it.
- On the light theme, the shine that runs across the Hushfeed settings title no longer washes the letters out. It's softer there now, so the title stays readable while it passes.
- TalkBack doesn't stop on the screen that holds the feed as a whole anymore. It used to read everything on it a second time and offer to activate it, which did nothing. The title, the countdown and both buttons are still read one by one.
- Tab on a keyboard or d-pad can't wander into the feed behind the daily hold anymore. It used to move from the hold into the video and the like and comment buttons underneath. Now it goes between the hold's buttons and the tabs along the bottom, which TalkBack can reach again too.
- With the feed lock on, coming back to TikTok no longer puts the "Tap to start the feed" layer on top of the lock screen. It took the first tap there, which could start a video behind the lock.
- With App lock up, Tab goes straight to Unlock. It used to stop on the black screen first, and TalkBack offered to press that screen, which did nothing. Anything TikTok opens while it's locked stays behind the lock screen too.

The [changelog](https://github.com/SysAdminDoc/hushfeed/blob/main/CHANGELOG.md) has every earlier release too.

How to update

1. Update Morphe Manager to 2.5.0 or newer, then refresh the Hushfeed source.
2. Patch TikTok 47.7.3 from APKMirror. Keep the manager's existing signing key so your login and settings carry over.

The `.mpp` download is a patch bundle, not a TikTok APK. [Installation instructions](https://github.com/SysAdminDoc/hushfeed#install).

What was checked

* All 147 TikTok patches applied to TikTok 47.7.3 with none failing.
* This exact bundle was patched onto TikTok 47.7.3 and run on a signed-in Galaxy S22. A walk through the whole app opened 27 screens with no crash.

hushgram.title: v0.0.20
hushgram.body:
Almost all of this release came from your requests. You can keep your own list of saved profiles with folders, and the glass tab bar can tick and click as you move between tabs. Settings categories now open on their own pages. The fix list below is a long one.

New in this release

- With `Page dots on a pill` on, you can hold the pill and slide left or right to flip through a carousel's pages, a page for each dot, the way Instagram's own dots work. Asked for in #651.

- `Hide Watch more reels` sits under `Watch again in the feed` in Feed. When a reel in your feed ends, the card it shows keeps Watch again and drops the big Watch more reels button. Starts off. Asked for in #652.

- `Shrink the pill as you scroll` in Tab bar shrinks the pill while you scroll down and restores it on the way up, with `Liquid glass look` off. `Hide the tab bar as you scroll` wins. Needs a restart. Asked for in #638.

- `Burn-in guard` fades the Add comment bar under a reel too, along with the other buttons, and tapping it brings them all back. Asked for in #648.

- `Open Saved profiles with a tab long press` under `Your saved profiles` in Profiles lets you pick a tab, Profile included, that opens your saved list when you hold it. A normal tap works as before. Needs `Saved profiles` on. Asked for in #629.

- `Fast scroll in Saved` under `Saved tab on your profile` in Profiles shows a handle at the right edge of Saved and your collections while you scroll. Drag it to jump anywhere. No restart needed. Starts off. Asked for in #644.

- `Keep the tab bar on Favorites` in Feed leaves the tab bar showing in Favorites. `Open Favorites with a tab long press` opens it from a tab you hold. Both ship in `Start Home on Following` and start off. Asked for in #643.

- A story's three dot menu has `Add to Stories priority`, which adds that account to your `Priority accounts` list and turns `Stories priority` on if needed. For someone already listed, it reads `Remove from Stories priority`. Asked for in #641.

- `Double tap to skip` in Reels and `Double tap to skip on feed videos` in Feed each get a `Skip length` slider, 5 to 30 seconds in steps of 5. It starts at 10, and the feed's arrows show it. Asked for in #645.

- `Haptic strength` in Tab bar sets the glass tab bar's tick from 25% to 200%. `Tap sound on the tab bar` clicks as the highlight moves, at the `Tap sound volume` you pick, except in silent or vibrate mode. Asked for in #640.

- `Glass in chats` now frosts a chat's message bar too, so messages blur as they scroll under it. `Glass reply box on stories`, new under Stories, gives the Send message box on stories the same glass. Starts off. Asked for in #391.

- `Launch screen in the accent color` in Layout fills the startup screen with your accent color, or Instagram's blue with `Accent color` off. A typed color shows as the nearest listed one, since Android draws that screen first. Starts off. Asked for in #528.

- `Seek bar position` under `Seek bar on stories` has `Below the Send message box`, which moves the story seek bar under the reply box. Where there's no room there, it stays above the box. Asked for in #636.

- With `Glass tab bar` on, Home's `See-through top bar`, a chat's glass header and message bar, and the story reply box get the pill's soft shine. `Bend light at the edges` bends their edges the way the pill's rim does. Asked for in #513 and #391.

- `Hide Subscribe on posts` sits under `Hide Follow on posts` in Feed. It takes just the Subscribe button off the top of posts in your feed, so Follow stays where it is. Starts off. Asked for in #622.

- `Hide the Create button on saved reels` in Reels takes the plus button off reels you open from Saved or a collection, and leaves it everywhere else. Starts off. Asked for in #620.

- `Speed in the story menu` under `Speed button on stories` moves Playback speed (1x, 1.5x, 2x) into a video story's three dot menu, and the story waits while you pick. Needs `Download any story` in your build. Starts off. Asked for in #621.

- `Keep photo locations from Instagram` under Ads and privacy stops Instagram reading where the photos and videos in your gallery were taken. Starts off. Asked for in #628.

- `Keep profile history` under Profiles remembers each profile's username, bio and picture, on your phone only. A toast says when one changed, and `Profile changes` lists every old one with a search box. Asked for in #590 and #611.

- HushGram's settings are now in Thai, thanks to MangaThatsFine in #593.

- `Hide the Join bar on channel posts` under Feed takes away the bar under a post that asks you to join the account's channel. The post stays. Starts off. Asked for in #625.

- New switches under Profiles take the Threads badge, Facebook and WhatsApp links, the profile song, interests, channel invites and the other banners from under the bio on other people's profiles. Yours keeps them. Each starts off. Asked for in #627.

- `Hide Reply on comments` sits under `Hide comments` in Comments. It takes Reply off each comment on posts and reels, and View more replies still opens a thread. Starts off. Asked for in #619.

- `Ask before a follow` under Profiles asks "Follow @username?" before a Follow or Follow back button follows anyone, on a profile or in a Followers or Following list. Other Follow buttons, like the one on stories, ask too. Starts off. Asked for in #631.

- `Saved profiles` in Profiles adds Save profile to anyone's profile menu, kept on your phone apart from Instagram's Favorites and Following. `Your saved profiles` lists them with search and folders you name. Settings exports carry the list. Starts off. Asked for in #629.

- `Hide the Like button on stories`, `Hide the Comment button on stories` and `Hide the Share button on stories` under Stories take those buttons off other people's stories, leaving no gap. Each starts off. Asked for in #618.

- `Keep hidden accounts in Favorites` sits under `Hidden accounts` in Feed. Turn it on and posts from accounts you've hidden still show when Home is on Favorites, while For you and Following leave them out. Starts off. Asked for in #601.

- `Hide posts from business and creator accounts` under Feed takes their posts out of Home and Following, friends who use one included, and collabs with one of them too. Favorites still shows them. Starts off. Asked for in #579.

- `Lock Saved` sits with the message locks in Messages. Saved, your collections and the search inside Saved stay covered until your fingerprint, face or screen lock says it's you, and your messages stay as they were. Starts off. Asked for in #597.

- `Mute button on reels` under Reels puts a speaker icon beside a reel. Tap it to turn sound off or on. `Mute button in clear mode` keeps it in clear mode too. Both start off. Asked for in #608.

- `Upload stories at full quality` adds `Video resolution` up to 2160p, `Video frame rate` to 120 fps, `Photo quality` to 100 and `Photo size` to 8192 px. Settings past what your phone's encoder handles drop back. Instagram still re-encodes them. Asked for in #37.

- `Loop this video` in a feed video's or reel's menu loops just that one while `Stop videos looping` is on. `Loop this story` does the same for a story while `Loop a story` is off. Asked for in #610.

- `Seek bar shape` under Feed gives the seek bars on feed videos, stories and reels a new look: a thin line, a thicker rounded bar, a bar split by a tall handle, or a wave. They grow while you drag. Asked for in #586 and #592.

- `Preview while you drag a seek bar` under Feed shows the time above your finger on feed videos, stories and reels, plus a picture of that moment or the paused video itself. Asked for in #567 and #592.

- `Keep the tab bar on a reel's profile` keeps the tab bar on a profile you open from a reel, and Back goes back to the reel. It starts off, in the Reels section of HushGram settings.

- `Swipe right on Home opens` picks what that swipe does: the camera, as it is now, or Search, Reels, Messages or Profile. Asked for in #589.

- `Picture in picture for reels` under Playback, below `Keep playing in the background`, shrinks a playing reel into a small window over other apps when you leave Instagram. Needs Android 15 or newer. Starts off. Asked for in #572.

- `Picture in picture for stories` under Playback does the same for stories. Leave Instagram while one plays and it shrinks into a small window that keeps going through the stories. Starts off. Asked for in #572.

- `Show it on the profile picture` under `Mark who doesn't follow you back` swaps the words for a badge on each profile picture in your Following list. Green check means they follow back, red cross means they don't. Starts off. Asked for in #572.

- New patch, `Search comments`. Its switch under Comments puts a search box above a post's comments. Type a word or name to jump to the next match, loading more as needed. Arrows step between matches. Unopened replies aren't searched. Asked for in #560.

- New patch, `Split the notes row`. Its switch under Messages splits the notes row at the top of your messages into three stacks (Instants, Notes and Stories), the layout Instagram is testing on some accounts. Takes a restart. Asked for in #558.

- New patch, `Hide Instagram Plus prompts`. Its switch under Ads and privacy takes the Try Instagram Plus card and See preview row off a chat you hold, plus other Plus offers shown the same way. Nothing from Plus turns on. Asked for in #559.

- `Hide the Community Standards reminder` under Messages takes the "Help keep Instagram a supportive place" banner off the bottom of a chat. Asked for in #588.

- `Who can call you` under Messages stops Instagram calls from ringing your phone: nobody, only people on your list, or everyone except them. Callers just get no answer. Asked for in #578.

- `Hide page number` under Feed takes the number like 3/5 off the corner of a carousel post. Starts off. Asked for in #581.

- `Hide story rows` under Feed takes out the rows of stories Instagram puts between posts on Home, like Expiring Stories. It's off until you turn it on. Asked for in #557.

- `Swipe through a chat's photos and posts` under Messages lets you open a photo, video or shared post from a chat and swipe up through the chat's other photos, videos and shared posts, in chat order. Asked for in #350.

- `Seek bar on photos with music` under Reels gives a reel that's a photo with a song the same seek bar and time as a video reel, following the song. Asked for in #10.

- `Jump a profile's posts to a date` puts a calendar on a profile's top bar. Pick a day and the posts grid goes back to that day, with older posts as you scroll. Asked for in #498.

- `Hide GIFs in comments` under Comments takes GIFs and stickers out of comments and the GIF button off the comment box. A comment with words keeps them. Asked for in #511.

- `Solid story rings` sits under `Story rings in the accent color` and makes a story's ring one shade of your color instead of running light to dark. Asked for in #519.

- `Ask what to save` under `Download button on reels` lets a tap on the icon pick the reel, its cover or its sound, whichever it has. A reel with nothing else to save still saves at once. Asked for in #524.

- `Save videos as MKV` under Downloads saves .mkv files instead of .mp4, for gallery apps that show blank thumbnails for VP9 or AV1. Nothing is re-encoded, and the account, date and link stay in. One-file videos stay .mp4. Asked for in #547.

- `Hide the search bar` under Sharing takes the search bar off the top of the share sheet. Asked for in #545.

- `Speed button on reels` has 2.5x in its list too, for talking videos that are still easy to follow past 2x. Asked for in #551.

- `Speed in the reel menu` under Reels adds Playback speed to the menu a reel's three dots open. Tap it and pick a speed from 0.5x to 3x, so the speed icon can stay off the reel. Asked for in #553.

- New patch, `Double tap to skip on Reels`. Its switch under Reels turns on Instagram's skip, 10 seconds back on the left, ahead on the right. The middle still likes. `A tap on a reel` has `Keep playing` now too. Asked for in #554.

- New patch, `Hold for 2x on feed videos`. Turn on its switch under Feed, then press and hold a video in your feed and it plays at 2x with Instagram's own speed-up. Let go and it's back to normal speed. Asked for in #552.

- New patch, `Hide the 2x popup on Reels`. Its switch under Reels takes the 2x label off a reel while you hold it to play faster, and the speed-up keeps working. Asked for in #552.

- `Tab icon size` under Tab bar draws the icons on the bottom tab bar bigger, from 110% up to 150% of Instagram's size. It works on Instagram's bar and the glass one, and a change shows right away. Asked for in #541.

- `Count on the heart` under Tab bar puts a number on the heart at the top of Home, like the one on Messages, instead of the red dot. It takes a restart. Asked for in #541.

- `History button on Home's header` under Tab bar puts a clock at the top of Home. One tap opens your viewing history. It starts off. Asked for in #228.

- `Accent color` has a `Custom` choice now, with a `Custom color` row for any hex color like #4A6B82. HushGram adjusts it where text would be hard to read. On Android 10 and older, only some colors take it. Asked for in #520.

- `Accent color` also has three calmer colors: Dusk blue, Pine and Slate. Asked for in #528.

- `Categories on their own page` under Settings entry opens a category on its own page, name at the top, instead of under its row. Back returns to the same spot in the list. Needs `Expandable categories` on. Asked for in #525.

- The viewing history has its own category in settings now, instead of sitting under Ads and privacy. Each row shows a picture, like a post's first photo, a reel's cover or a person's profile photo. Asked for in #228.

- Viewing history pictures load from Instagram's image servers once and stay on your phone. `Clear viewing history` deletes them with the list. Hold a row for `Copy link`, `Open profile` or `Remove from history`. Asked for in #228.

- `Double tap to skip on feed videos` under Feed makes a double tap on a video's left side go back 10 seconds and the right go ahead 10. Arrows flash where you tapped. The middle still likes. Starts off. Asked for in #562.

- New patch, `Hide lives in Reels`. Its switch under Reels leaves out the live broadcasts Instagram slips in between reels, on the Reels tab and when you swipe through reels you opened from Explore. Asked for in #566.

- New patch, `Save in the post menu`. Its switch under Feed adds Save (or Remove from saved) to the menu behind a post's three dots. `Hide the Save button` next to it takes the bookmark off feed posts. Asked for in #569.

- New patch, `Hide Made with Edits`. Its switch under Feed takes the "Made with Edits" label out of the line under a post's author, and the song, the place and the other labels keep taking turns there. Asked for in #570.

- New patch, `Watch again in the feed`. With its switch on under Feed, Watch again at the end of a reel in your feed plays it over in place instead of opening Reels. `Watch more reels` still opens Reels. Asked for in #568.

- `Seek bar on the bottom edge` under `Seek bar on feed videos` moves the bar down onto the video's bottom edge, so a scroll is less likely to catch it. Asked for in #567.

- `Take a scroll break` now lets you pick how long you scroll, from 5 minutes up to 2 hours, and a `Break length` slider sets the break from 5 to 120 minutes. Asked for in #297.

- `Stop background feed refresh` under Battery stops the job that wakes your phone about every half hour to fetch your feed. Your feed loads when you open Instagram, and messages and notifications still come in. Reported in #341.

- `Ask before a like` covers reels now. Tap the heart on a reel and it asks "Like or unlike this post?" first, same as in the feed. Asked for in #603.

- `Ask before a like` asks about the heart beside a comment too, so a stray tap doesn't like it. Double tapping a comment still likes it straight away. Asked for in #614.

- `Ask for each chat` under `Lock your messages` asks you to unlock every chat you open, and the inbox when you go back. Off, one unlock covers everything until you leave Instagram. Starts off. Asked for in #649.

Fixes

- `Glass tab bar` no longer flickers to its plain tint while you swipe through the feed or messages, and a video under it keeps its blur instead of flashing sharp. The other glass bars and backgrounds get it too. Reported in #429.

- A settings restore now puts a saved profile with no folder into the folder the file has for it, and Undo takes it back out. Before, only newly added profiles got their folders. Asked about in #629.

- With `Carousel arrows` on, scrolling the feed with your finger starting on an arrow now scrolls it. Before, the arrow held on to the touch and the feed didn't move.

- `Default playback quality` no longer leaves a reel stuttering on a slow connection. A video that falls behind now steps down one quality at a time, and new videos start no higher than that for two minutes. Reported in #599.

- With `Lock your messages` on, opening a chat from a notification no longer sends Seen or clears the unread mark before you unlock. Seen goes once you unlock, unless `Read messages without the seen receipt` holds it. Reported in #649.

- With `Glass tab bar` floating, the story camera's bottom row (gallery button, Story, Reel and Live picker) no longer sits under the navigation buttons. The glass also stops blurring while the camera's open, so the camera has less to do. Reported in #646.

- With `See-through top bar` on, Instagram no longer keeps redrawing the screen after you leave Home for another tab, which used battery even on a still screen. Found while building #513.

- `Glass in chats` now shows up as soon as a chat opens. If the chat sat still right after it opened, the top bar and message bar could stay plain until you scrolled. Found while checking #391.

- With `Glass tab bar` and `Show content behind the tab bar` on, the floating tab bar now steps aside in an open chat instead of covering the reply box on Android 17. Reported in #632.

- With `Full screen Reels`, `Full screen Home` or `Full screen Messages` hiding the bars, the comment box no longer slips below the bottom of the screen on some Samsung phones. Reported in #626.

- `Hide the Create button on reels` now also takes the plus button off reels you open from Saved, a profile or a post, which get a different top bar on 454. Found while building #620.

- A reel link opened from another app now plays that reel first, instead of a reel Instagram had saved or fetched ahead. It's the new `Open reel links on that reel` switch under Reels, on to start. Reported in #606.

- `Recent unfollowers` now saves your Followers list when Instagram shows a few fewer accounts than your follower count, like 547 of 550. Before, nothing was saved. It allows one missing account per 50 followers. Reported in #624.

- With `Stories fill the screen` on, a reel shared to a story fills the screen right away, without the rounded card and reply bar showing first, and its sides no longer get cut off. Reported in #618.

- With `Tab bar layout` set to a bar Instagram didn't pick, a tab like Home no longer opens blank after Android closes Instagram in the background. HushGram builds the missing page again. Reported in #535.

- Picking `Download` or `Loop this story` in a story's menu plays the story on once the menu closes. It used to stay paused until you tapped it. Reported in #610.

- Home stops asking for more pages after a few short ones again, with `Hide suggested posts` or another Feed switch taking most of each page out. Instagram's own page loads kept starting the count over. Reported in #579.

- The `See who a story mentions` list opens again when you come back to the story after opening a post on a profile you picked from it. Before, it only came back if you didn't tap anything on that profile. Reported in #403.

- With `Peek at the next carousel page` on, Instagram no longer crashes while you scroll Home past carousels. When Instagram reused a carousel for another post, it could look for a page slot the carousel no longer had.

- With `Peek at the next carousel page` on, `Ambient light` glows around the smaller page you see instead of leaving a square behind it, where the full-size page would have been. Reported in #585.

- With `Full size covers` on, Explore scrolls smoothly again. Grid pictures are now decoded just big enough to stay sharp in their tile instead of at full size, which stuttered and used more memory. Reported in #595.

- With a large font or display size, a story's reply box and buttons no longer cover it. `Keep story buttons below the story` under Stories, on by default, moves them into the space below. Reported in #598.

- With `Logo and titles at the start` on, Home's logo stays at the start when you scroll. Instagram padded it to stay centered once the little arrow beside it showed up. Reported in #602.

- `Clear saved copies now`, and the clear that runs on its own, empty the photo cache on Instagram 454 too. That version keeps its pictures in a new folder, so nothing was being freed.

- `Backgrounds in the accent color` now reaches the message list. Its rows and search field stayed near-black under a colored page because that screen takes its grays from code instead of the theme. Refs #577.

- `Pure black dark mode` no longer paints a note's bubble, the Instagram Plus card, the comments sheet or the strip under it black on top of `Backgrounds in the accent color`. Refs #577.

- With `Gray out stories you've watched`, the story row no longer puts watched stories ahead of new ones after it reloads, and the next batch stays after the ones you had. Reported in #241.

- With `Gray out stories you've watched`, the highlight tiles at the end of the story row stay there instead of jumping ahead of watched stories, where they looked like a watched story with a new ring. Reported in #241.

- `Ambient light` shows on the posts that were missing it. Instagram's frame around those pictures comes out a pixel taller than the picture, and the glow was drawn on that frame with no room to show. Reported in #580.

- `Ambient light` glows around a reel that doesn't fill the screen when `Rounded corners on Reels` is on. The rounding was cutting the glow off with the empty space around the video. Reported in #580.

- `Save every page without asking` works on the download icon beside a reel too, so a carousel opened from Explore, Search or Reels saves all its pages with no popup. Reported in #190.

- A reel's seek bar no longer ends up in the strip at the bottom of the screen when the tab bar has moved out of the way, so scrubbing can't swipe you home. Reported in #450.

- A reel's seek bar keeps clear of the bottom edge on Samsung phones with the gesture hint hidden too, and the caption and buttons move up with it. Dragging a raised bar now seeks instead of opening the long-press menu. Reported in #633.

- `Glass tab bar` now works on tablets and a foldable's inner screen. It keeps Instagram's phone layout there, since the glass needs the tab bar along the bottom and the big screen layout only has the rail down the side.

- With `Hide the Create button` on, a long press on your profile's menu opens the HushGram settings again. With the button gone, the long press couldn't tell it was on your own profile. Reported in #431.

- On the `Install next to Instagram` copy, holding your profile's menu opens the HushGram settings now, and every feature that finds a part of Instagram's screen by name works there too. Reported in #431.

- `See-through top bar` reaches behind the clock on more phones. Where Home's posts already run under the clock, the glass now covers that strip. Where the tabs swipe sideways, only Home's page moves up. Reported in #462.

- With `Glass tab bar` on, the seek bar on a reel opened outside the Reels tab sits above the gesture handle instead of on the screen's edge, where scrubbing swiped you home. Reported in #450.

- The floating `Glass tab bar` pill now frosts over a playing reel instead of staying clear, and on Home and Profile the sharp screen no longer shows through half of it. Reported in #583.

- `Start feed videos with sound` now turns the sound on for every video on Home, the same as tapping a speaker. Mute one and the rest stay muted. On silent or vibrate they start muted. Reported in #504.

- `Start reels with sound` now covers reels you open from a profile, yours or someone else's, which used to start muted. Reported in #596.

- `Keep playing in the background` keeps going after you open a video from your feed, Reels or stories. Those used to stop a few seconds after you left Instagram. Reported in #497.

- `See who a story mentions` opens its list again after you watch the story of a profile you went to from it. That story used to end the list, so coming back left it closed. Reported in #403.

- Explore no longer leaves two blank spots in every fourth row with `Full size covers` on, and `Ask for larger photos` got the same fix. Reels show Meta's `Translated with AI` again with either switch on. Reported in #433 and #556.

- `Keep a viewing history` now records the reels you watch. It only heard about them while `Download button on reels` was on, so with that icon off the Reels list stayed empty. Reported in #228.

- With `Rounded corners on Reels` on, opening the comments on a wide reel no longer cuts its video down to a thin strip. The rounded edge now moves up with the video. Reported in #522.

- `Phone layout on big screens` now takes the rail down the side away too. It only changed Home's header on 454, since Instagram's main screen asks a second copy of the width check. Reported in #515.

- `See-through top bar` now reaches up behind the clock again instead of stopping at the header's top edge. Reported in #513 and #521.

- `See-through top bar` no longer draws an empty frosted band across Home when nothing in the header is showing. Only the strip behind the clock stays. Reported in #513.

- With `Keep Home's top bar` on, the Instagram logo and the buttons beside it no longer vanish after you come back to Instagram from another app. Reported in #513.

- `Start tab` now works when you open Instagram from its icon without a saved `Tab order`. On 454 Instagram picks the first tab before the tab bar is built, and that pick used to need a saved order. Reported in #534.

- `Clean up Reels` no longer stops patching when the APK numbers the Friends tab's icon differently. It now also finds the tab by how Instagram builds it. Reported in #533.

- Reels on the Reels tab fill the screen again when `Hide the tab bar on Reels` slides the bar away or `Run Reels behind the tab bar` is on. They used to sit low under a black band. Reported in #544.

- The follow lists switch under `Hide suggested people on profiles` now also clears Suggested subscriptions from your own Following list's Subscriptions tab and takes the Discover people button off your own lists. Reported in #539.

- The color you pick in `Story ring size` reaches the rings in Home's stories row again. On 454 Instagram draws those rings through a second copy of its gradient code, which the patch now colors too. Reported in #518.

- `Story rings in the accent color` no longer leaves a pink tail on a story's ring. On 454 the default ring ends in a lavender Instagram added, and that one now takes your color too. Reported in #519.

- A liked heart in your accent color no longer has a thin light edge around it. Instagram draws the empty heart under the filled one, and with `Accent color` on that outline is left out once a post is liked. Reported in #519.

- With a bigger `Tab icon size` the tab bar's icons are no longer cut off at their old size, so Home keeps its roof and your profile picture stays round. Reported in #541.

- The retro camera app icon fills the whole icon now, whatever shape your launcher gives it. It used to sit small on a white tile. Reported in #565.

- `Don't report Blend visits` now also keeps the time you last opened a Blend to yourself. Opening one sent that time in a request of its own, which the switch didn't cover. Reported in #474.

- A 60 fps reel or story no longer saves at 30 fps when Instagram's own file is the same size as the smoother track. A tie on size now goes to the higher frame rate. Reported in #546.

- A save the connection drops partway through gets one more try right away. A 1080p story whose download was cut off used to fall back to the 720p file. Reported in #546.

- With several HushGram icons in the column beside a reel, the column no longer runs up past the top bar and cuts off Like. It's drawn just small enough to fit, and every icon still takes its own taps. Reported in #516.

- With `Glass tab bar` on, a reel's seek bar is easy to grab again. Its touch area covers the top of the bar, and dragging there moves through the reel instead of pressing a tab. Reported in #526.

- With `Glass tab bar` on, the pill no longer pops back up over a chat's message box when the keyboard opens or closes. The bar stays hidden while a chat is open now.

- With `Page dots on a pill` on, a carousel's buttons sit right under the photo, the way they do on a single photo. Instagram kept an empty strip there for the dots the pill replaces. Reported in #527.

- With `Pure black dark mode` on, a photo or GIF in a comment no longer has gray corners. Instagram's newer comments screen has its own dark gray theme, and that theme goes black now too. Reported in #538.

- On an account that doesn't have Instagram's Friends tab, tapping Friends again after you've left it opens it again. It used to do nothing until you tapped Reels first. Reported in #571.

- With `Pick friends` on, holding the Friends tab opens the list again on builds where Instagram gives each tab a hold of its own, which only cleared the tab's tooltip. Reported in #571.

- Holding the Friends tab with `Pick friends` on opens the list on Instagram 454 again. It only showed the tab's name before. Reported in #616.

- With `Glass tab bar` on and the classic tab bar layout, reels no longer jump up and down. On phones with no navigation bar room, two parts of the pill kept moving the reel back and forth. Reported in #512.

- With `Pure black dark mode` on, the strip behind the navigation bar is black while comments are open and under a reel opened from the feed. It used to show the video through it. Reported in #571.

- `Rounded post corners` now rounds the top corners of a reel in the feed too. The shadow behind its name row stayed square over them, which showed with `Ambient light` on. Reported in #571.

- New `Keep the comment bar's space` switch under the comment bar switches in Reels. A reel opened from a post or profile used to slide into the hidden bar's space. This keeps that space empty so nothing moves. Reported in #523.

- With `Seek bar on feed videos` on, a swipe up or down that starts on a video's seek bar scrolls Home instead of doing nothing. Dragging along the bar still moves through the video.

- The Saved bookmark on your profile opens Saved again. Instagram now ignores its own Saved link unless Instagram itself sent it, so tapping the bookmark did nothing. Reported in #492.

Other changes

- Settings search knows more words, like "nav bar" for the Tab bar, "dm" for Messages and "colour" for color. Categories sit in groups with a chip for each, and a category's page has buttons to jump to another one. Asked for in #642.

- Settings categories now open on their own page with the category buttons pinned on top. `Descriptions behind an info button` starts on, so a switch shows its name and a small i. A category's rows join into one rounded card. Asked for in #650.

- `Seek bar shape` now shapes story progress segments and videos opened from chats, no seek bar switch needed. `Ambient light in stories` fills a story's corners and top strip with glow. `Ambient light` on its own no longer lights stories. Asked for in #630.

- `Save comment photo` now saves a comment's GIF sticker too. Press and hold the comment and pick Save. A sticker that's only on Giphy still has no Save row. Asked for in #623.

- The diagnostic report has a `[SCREEN]` part now. It names the screen you were on, which tabs show, and the views covering most of it, so a report sent right after a blank screen shows what was in front. Asked for in #535.

- Dusk blue, Pine and Slate are now full color sets. Story rings and Instagram's other gradients run through three colors, likes and badges get the set's own color, and backgrounds start from its screen color.

- With `Keep a seek bar on Reels` on, Instagram's own track now glides between position updates too, and a round handle stays on the line's end. Reported in #10.

- `Bend light at the edges` works on the standard glass pill as well as the liquid one, round whatever corners you picked. It sits under `Blur behind the tab bar` now, since the bend needs the blur. Asked for in #391.

- The `Instagram gradient on dark` app icon is bigger on the home screen, about as big as the other icons. Reported in #327.

- `Pure black dark mode` now also blacks out the menu you get by holding a message or an inbox chat, the Instagram Plus card over it, the menu behind the + in a chat and the notes above your chats. Asked for in #543 and #635.

- With `Full screen Reels` hiding the status bar, the Reels and Friends tabs and the buttons at the top of a reel now sit just below a punch hole camera instead of under it. Asked for in #525.

- `Select text` opens a comment, caption or bio in HushGram's own dark window now, black with `Pure black dark mode`, instead of the phone's gray one. Asked for in #525.

- The story mentions sheet from the top bar floats over the story as glass now, with the story blurred behind it on Android 12 and up. Phones that can't blur get a nearly solid tint so names stay readable. Asked for in #525.

- `Glass in chats` gives the back, call and video buttons real glass circles that match the liquid tab bar, with a lit rim instead of flat grey. The thin line under a chat's top bar is gone too. Asked for in #537 and #542.

- With debug logging on, the diagnostic report has a timed line each time a tab bar moves a screen, the Reels viewer, a sheet or the space under a reel. Reported in #509 and #222.

- In Morphe Manager, `Call blocker` now sits under Privacy and `Hide the Community Standards reminder` under Fixes, so the Messages group stays short. Both switches are still on the Messages settings page.

Behind the scenes

- `scripts/gen-readme-patches.py` writes the README's patch table and counts from `patches-list.json` and leaves the rest of the README alone.

- The release walk now reads the settings overview while its own header shows HushGram's name, Home's welcome screen on 454, a long reel with its scrubber, and a screen with the activity tooltip up.

- `patch-all-builds.ps1` merges a split bundle before patching it, like the other patching scripts.

- The release facts check reads the patch count and target build from the description's sentences, so a change's bullet that counts patches no longer stops a release.

- Morphe Desktop 2.1.1 now has its reviewed advisory exceptions, so the audit accepts it.

The [changelog](https://github.com/SysAdminDoc/HushGram/blob/main/CHANGELOG.md) has every earlier release too.

How to update

1. Update Morphe Manager to 2.5.0 or newer, then refresh the HushGram source.
2. Patch Instagram `454.0.0.54.77`. [Supported Instagram builds](https://github.com/SysAdminDoc/HushGram#supported-instagram-builds) lists the builds that work.
3. Install over your current patched Instagram with the manager's existing signing key. Keep that key so updates keep working.

The `.mpp` download is a patch bundle, not an Instagram APK. [Installation instructions](https://github.com/SysAdminDoc/HushGram#install).

What was checked

The bundle patched Instagram 454.0.0.54.77 cleanly, and the whole app was walked on a Galaxy S22 with every screen opened and no crash.
